# Zoho Analytics REST API v2

> Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.2) bundle for the Zoho Analytics REST API v2: 168 endpoints across 10 domains, with the conventions, OAuth scopes, roles, identifiers and 278 error codes they share. Base URL https://analyticsapi.zoho.com, path prefix /restapi/v2, OAuth 2.0 with the Zoho-oauthtoken scheme, structured input in a single JSON parameter named CONFIG.

Read overview.md first, then how-to-use-this-bundle.md for the frontmatter contract and navigation rules. Links inside the bundle are relative to the document that contains them; resolve them against that document's URL under https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf. Paths beginning with a slash appear only in frontmatter (resource, sources, api.openapi.file) and are relative to the bundle root, which is https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf.

## Start here

- [Overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/overview.md): what the API is, the object model, and the five conventions every call shares.
- [How to use this bundle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/how-to-use-this-bundle.md): directory layout, the api frontmatter contract, navigation rules for agents and generators.
- [Endpoint catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/endpoint-catalog.md): all 168 endpoints with method, path, operation ID, group, scope and success status.
- [Bundle index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/index.md): the full table of contents.

## Foundations (rules shared by every call)

- [Authentication](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/foundations/authentication.md): OAuth 2.0 flow, Authorization header, token lifetime and refresh.
- [OAuth scopes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/foundations/oauth-scopes.md): all 31 scopes and the operations each one covers.
- [Data centers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/foundations/data-centers.md): API host and accounts host per region.
- [Request conventions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/foundations/request-conventions.md): URL structure, headers, and how to encode the CONFIG parameter per HTTP method.
- [Response envelope](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/foundations/response-envelope.md): the success and failure JSON shapes, the 204 no-body pattern, file responses.
- [Error code catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/foundations/error-codes.md): 278 codes with meaning, HTTP status, resolution and the operations that raise them.
- [Error codes quick reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/foundations/error-codes-quick-reference.md): one compact row per code.
- [Roles and permissions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/foundations/roles-and-permissions.md): organization roles, workspace roles, view-level share permissions.
- [Permission matrix](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/foundations/permission-matrix.md): scope, organization header and required role for every endpoint.
- [Identifiers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/foundations/identifiers.md): every ID used in paths and headers, and the call that returns it.
- [Filter criteria syntax](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/foundations/filter-criteria-syntax.md): the SQL-like row filter used by exports, row writes, shares and embeds.
- [Asynchronous jobs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/foundations/asynchronous-jobs.md): job codes, polling, callbacks, batch imports, retention.
- [Rate limits and quotas](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/foundations/rate-limits-and-quotas.md): throttles, concurrency guards, plan quotas, API units.
- [HTTP status codes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/foundations/http-status-codes.md): which status each failure class returns.
- [Glossary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/foundations/glossary.md): every Zoho Analytics object and term.

## API domains

- [Organization Management](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/domains/organization-management/overview.md): organizations, plan and resource usage, name to ID resolution.
- [Users and Groups](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/domains/users-and-groups/overview.md): organization users, workspace users, workspace groups.
- [Workspace Management](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/domains/workspace-management/overview.md): workspaces, folders, preferences, White Label domain access.
- [Data Modeling and Schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/domains/data-modeling-and-schema/overview.md): tables, columns, lookups, query tables, formulas, variables.
- [Data Operations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/domains/data-operations/overview.md): import, export, row writes, datasource sync.
- [Views Management](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/domains/views-management/overview.md): view lifecycle, favourites, trash, auto analysis.
- [Reports and Dashboards](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/domains/reports-and-dashboards/overview.md): analysis views and dashboards.
- [Share and Publish](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/domains/share-and-publish/overview.md): sharing, public and private URLs, embed URLs, slideshows.
- [Schedules and Alerts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/domains/schedules-and-alerts/overview.md): recurring email delivery of views.
- [Data Science and Machine Learning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/domains/dsml/overview.md): AutoML training, deployment and scoring.

## Workflows

- [Workflow playbooks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/workflows/index.md): 8 step-by-step procedures spanning several endpoints, including bootstrapping identifiers, asynchronous export, large imports, sharing with row filters, multi-tenant embedding, email schedules, user provisioning and AutoML.

## Machine-readable

- [manifest.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/manifest.json): bundle version, OKF version, counts, entry points.
- [endpoint-catalog.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/references/endpoint-catalog.json): every endpoint with method, path, scopes, permission, error codes and document paths.
- [OpenAPI specifications](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/references/openapi/): OpenAPI 3 files, one per domain plus shared components.

## Optional

- [SDK examples](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/sdk-examples/index.md): per-endpoint code samples in cURL, C#, Go, Java, PHP, Python, Node.js, Ruby and Deluge.
- [SDK clients](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/okf/foundations/sdk-clients.md): how each official client library is constructed.
